headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with a few high flyers and modest profit pressure.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑single digits to over 50% YoY. Coforge led with 53.6% growth, while Infosys and Wipro saw modest top‑line expansion and profit slowdown. AI contributed to earnings for several firms but detailed AI revenue was limited. Guidance remained cautious, with most companies keeping outlooks unchanged.

themes.title: AI‑driven deals
themes.detail: Several firms cited AI‑led pipeline or revenue growth, supporting higher margins and deal wins.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Despite revenue gains, profit growth lagged for some, reflecting cost pressures and lower dividend yields.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Revenue grew 22.7% YoY and profit rose 19.6% on strong AI‑led pipeline.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and profit grew only 6% YoY, prompting a lower FY27 guidance.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% YoY, with no concrete AI revenue disclosed.
